Pātimokkha
or Prā(a)timokṣa sūtras. Bud. Pāli an. Skt. formed nucleus of Vinayapiṭaka; is a list of transgressions an. their atonements: Pāli text appears to belong to Theravādins, an. Skt. text to the Sarvāstivādins; present text compiled about 1st Cent. B. C.; Chinese an. Tibetan translations also available; rules vary in diff. texts belonging to diff. schools. The original text prob. contained 152 rules but later on extended to 227.
See Wint. HIL. II. p.. 22-4. 232; B. C. Law, His.. of Pāli Lit. I. p.. 48-49. For a summary of the contents of Pātimokkha, see B. C. Law op. cit. p.. 49-61. See also W. Pachow, Comparative Study of the Prātimokṣa. The Sino-Indian Cultural Society, Santiniketan, 1955 an. Encycl. of Religion an. Ethics IX. p.. 675-77. [Page025-a.
